item.title: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career
item.description: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career, and his work will continue to change lives even after his passing.

item.title: Victim advocate helps other women and girls after spending teen years in Figueroa Corridor
item.description: Police say some of the women you see wearing revealing outfits along "the Blade" are not adults at all. ABC7 spoke to a human trafficking survivor who is now helping other women and young girls get out.

item.title: How the Japanese locations in 'Rental Family' became more characters in the film
item.description: From city streets to historic restaurants to a unique digital art museum, the locations in "Rental Family" tell even more of the story. The film, starring Brendan Fraser, is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Gov. Newsom demands refund checks for Americans after SCOTUS strikes down Trump's tariffs
item.description: "These tariffs were nothing more than an illegal cash grab... Every dollar unlawfully taken must be refunded immediately - with interest. Cough up!" Newsom wrote.

item.title: 29-year-old man charged with killing renowned Caltech astrophysicist at his Llano home
item.description: A 29-year-old Llano man is in custody, charged with killing a Caltech astrophysicist Monday after carjacking his own relative and burglarizing a home.

item.title: Woman shot in face with less-lethal round during ICE protest files claim against Los Angeles police
item.description: The 25-year-old says she is still suffering physical and emotional pain after police shot her with a less-lethal round just centimeters below her eye.

item.title: Temps begin to warm, making for lovely SoCal weekend after series of storms
item.description: Southern California will see a mild and sunny weekend as temperatures slowly begin to climb after a few cold days.

item.title: 1 dead, 2 injured after car crashes into pole in Pacoima
item.description: One person was killed and two others were injured after a vehicle collided with a pole in Pacoima, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

item.title: Memo shows LAFD tried to 'protect' Mayor Bass ahead of release of Palisades after-action report
item.description: In a confidential memo uncovered by ABC7, it appears LAFD was concerned about potential harm to its reputation and the mayor's reputation over the handling of the deadly fire.

item.title: Man rams car into LADWP-owned facility near Las Vegas; police looking into possible act of terrorism
item.description: Police are looking into a possible act of terrorism after a man rammed his car into an LADWP-owned power facility near Las Vegas.
